## Context / Problem
Story anguished-grown-junebug (1783-208c-59e9-4096) removed the visual workflow editor but deliberately left `pyproject.toml` untouched. `scripts/dependency_audit.py:50` (`DEPENDENCY_MAP_FILES`) treats ANY edit to `pyproject.toml` as touching the dependency map (the deliberate, package-blind "touch it, you own it" rule from bug 63e8). The committed lock carries HIGH advisories tracked by unhelpful-supersmart-chrysalis (f7dc-132b-057a-476c), including one with no published fix. So the editor-removal change could not pass `pip-audit` with these edits in it. The leftovers are inert: the wheel builds with 0 editor files with them present.

## Blocker check (2026-10-25)
f7dc-132b-057a-476c is closed. `pip-audit` over the committed lock (uv export, all extras, no deps) reports 1 advisory: oauthlib 3.3.1, PYSEC-2026-4114, fixed only in 4.0.0 (transitive; no pin in this repo). Its OSV severity is CVSS 3.1 `AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N`, base score 6.8 by calculation, which is the MEDIUM band; `scripts/dependency_audit.py` fails only CRITICAL/HIGH/unrated and warns on MEDIUM. So no HIGH advisory remains and the audit should warn, not fail, on this patchset; the `Verified +1` criterion below is what confirms it. The 4 hunks are still at the line numbers below on origin/main 47e431de04a.

## Approach
Remove the 4 stale hunks in one change. This change touches the dependency map, so `pip-audit` must be green on its patchset.

## Scope
Edit `pyproject.toml` only (line numbers on origin/main b97d414b8e2):
1. `:370-373` — the comment block and `"src/rebar/llm/workflow/editor_assets/dist/**/*",` entry in `[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel].artifacts` (the editor bundle glob).
2. `:382-383` comment and `:388` `"**/node_modules",` in the wheel `exclude` list.
3. `:403` `"**/node_modules",` in the sdist `exclude` list.
4. `:743` the `e2e:` entry in `[tool.pytest.ini_options].markers`, plus the `:550` comment `(prompt_authoring/snapshot) carry justified noqas` reworded to name only the remaining snapshot site.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `git grep -n -E 'editor_assets|prompt_authoring|node_modules|"e2e:' -- pyproject.toml` prints nothing.
- [ ] `uv build --wheel` succeeds and `unzip -l dist/*.whl | grep -c editor_assets` prints `0`.
- [ ] The Gerrit change reaches `Verified +1` with the `pip-audit` job green, and `LLM-Review +1`.
